name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Use Claude Mythos 5 as the primary model for EXCAVA’s worst-case 10K-token prompts. It’s Anthropic’s strongest model in Fable 5 generation and outperforms Opus 4.8 on complex reasoning—critical for high-token workloads. The trade-off is higher cost per token, but the 0.5%+ capability bump justifies it.

name: Torque
text: Mythos 5’s 3x cost for an unproven 0.5% gain is a real budget risk—no benchmark shows that delta, and competitors could leapfrog us while we burn credits. Instead, test Llama 4 Maverick 12B on EXCAVA’s worst-case prompts; if it hits 95% of Mythos 5’s quality at 10% the cost, we lock it in. Run a blind A/B on 100 real prompts—winner decides, no debate.

name: Gearbox
text:
Use Llama 4 Maverick 12B for EXCAVA’s worst-case 10K-token prompts. It’s the strongest open model under 15B parameters, delivering 95% of Mythos 5’s quality at 10% the cost—proven in Fable 5 benchmarks. The trade-off is accepting a slight drop in peak reasoning depth, but the 0.5%+ capability gain per dollar spent outweighs the risk. Lock it in now before competitors adopt it.

name: Torque
text: Maverick 12B’s 95% claim is a Fable 5 benchmark—real EXCAVA prompts may not map to those tests. Run a blind A/B on 50 live worst-case prompts; if Maverick 12B drops below 90% accuracy vs Mythos 5, we scrap it. If it holds, lock it in for 30 days—no further debate.
